items.author: Jordan M.
items.text: Fit on my DF3 is dialed and the embroidery looks even better in person. Gets compliments every round.

items.text: Premium feel without the bulky look. Magnetic closure stays put in the bag and the velvet lining is soft on the putter.

items.text: Finally a cover that matches the putter. Quality stitching, fun design, and it feels built to last.
